intro: Lanternertragis arrives with the familiar pitch: AI analysis, automatic entries, a US$250 start and a practice account. The pitch is polished. The fine print is where the questions begin, and that is what this review measures.
The mechanics are simple: AI models scan markets, the platform suggests entries, and a partner broker executes. The minimum is US$250, the registration is free, and a practice account comes included.
This review is built from the platform own words - every claim, fee note and disclosure it publishes. Where the page disagrees with itself, we flag it. The score follows the evidence.
whatItClaims: No platform fees - broker spreads and overnight charges still apply.
Payouts reportedly within a day.
11 crypto assets through broker partners.
A free demo account with practice funds.
Around-the-clock support through the partner desk.
whatWeChecked: The template marks: unfilled placeholders left in the wording.
The performance story: no verified track record behind the return claims.
The number reuse: one score figure doing more than one job.
The deposit terms: minimum amount, payment methods and where the money sits.
The demo claim: practice account confirmed in the signup flow.
The payout promise: within-a-day wording without processing detail.

Risk settings before the first trade.
cons: Two conflicting support figures.
Restriction lists disagree.
Unfilled template placeholders.
No verified track record.
redFlags: Performance language with no dates attached.
A broker relationship described in one vague sentence.
Ownership details missing from the public pages.

faqs.q: What does the published score actually mean?
faqs.a: It does double duty - a platform score and an early community response - and neither is independently verified. Treat both as marketing until proven otherwise.

faqs.q: How much support does it offer?
faqs.a: Unclear - around-the-clock coverage is claimed, while other sections quote different figures. Ask support to reconcile them before you fund anything.
Yes - the platform offers automatic and manual modes, so you can follow the signals or confirm each entry yourself.
The lists conflict - different sections of the site name different countries. Confirm your eligibility with support before depositing.
US$250, funded by bank card, bank transfer, PayPal or Skrill. It is trading capital in your balance, not a fee - and it is exposed to market risk once live.

bottomLine: What we found is a real service wrapped in marketing that outruns its own fine print. Trade the service, not the marketing.
The verdict holds at 4.8: research it, demo it, and if you fund it, fund the minimum. The platform earns a careful start, not blind trust.
